notes.title: FLOWERS -Le volume sur hiver- is Now Available!
notes.content:
After many years of development, we've finally reached the finale of the FLOWERS series. Thank you, all the fans, for your patience and love!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42412741/95ec7953f4b0720030c6b998b5590b486c27c81f.png[/img]

In this final chapter, you'll follow Suoh as she tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of her beloved Amitié partner, Mayuri. But winter is hash, with many new challenges she must face with her friends. But after the ice thaws and the snows melt, what will be revealed?

The final game in the Flowers visual novel series from Innocent Grey brings the stories of the beloved characters we have followed through the seasons to an emotional close.

We're celebrating its release with a special 10% off launch week discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1921560/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_hiver/

If you'd like to stay up to date with JAST goings-on, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/jast] be sure to follow us on Steam![/url]

You can also check out our [url=https://twitter.com/jastusa]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/jastusa]Facebook[/url] to get our latest news and ramblings.

Want to chat with other visual novel fans?
Come [url= https://discord.gg/rMGjzQE]hang out on Discord[/url]!
